0022600088.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons, with the Bulls visiting the Raptors. Chicago is missing Dailyn Swain, Jordan Hawkins and Nic Claxton, who are out, while Isaac Okoro, Leonard Miller, Tobe Awaka and Zach Collins are listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions, and Toronto is without Brandon Ingram and Nate Bittle, who are both out. The Bulls lost all three meetings with the Raptors in 2025-26, most recently 139-109 in Chicago on March 18, 2026.
